campaign: MetaTask v1.3 pilot - Cross-Language Replay-Engine Conformance Suite (7 nodes, competitive mode, weight sum 10000)
campaignStatus: DRAFTS VALIDATED LOCALLY - not yet published. Publish via scripts/metatask-v13-pilot/publish-harness.mts (specs -> task) with allowPreActivation: true (draft section 7 escape hatch; H_ACT3 unannounced at authoring time).

protocol.activationNote: Competitive mode is gated on H_ACT3 (draft section 7), unannounced at authoring time. The pilot publishes with allowPreActivation: true - the writer-side escape hatch; replay applies no height gate, so the pilot replays identically before and after H_ACT3.

specValidationReading: Every spec carries the v1.2.1 three-item validation block (mandatory at/after H_ACT2=191500): null_tolerance boolean true (null/missing/empty input -> exit 2 invalid with the location in detail), enumeration_closure with a closure string plus integer self-check counts (each script's EXPECTED_CHECKS constant, asserted on the pass path; S3 additionally pins the 16-vector legacy set identity), and proposition_fidelity referencing the independent correspondence artifact (acceptance-sheet.md, published as a metafile BEFORE the specs; placeholder ARTIFACT_PIN:acceptance-sheet until then).
publishProcedure: Gate: python3 scripts/metatask-v13-pilot/validate-pilot-drafts.py -> PILOT DRAFTS READY and python3 scripts/metatask-v13-pilot/selftest-pilot-specs.py green.

Upload the four binary metafiles: bundles/s2a-python-base.bundle, bundles/s2b-go-base.bundle, bundles/s2c-ts-harness-base.bundle (workspace.baseRef backfill) and vector-set/vector-set.tar.gz (VECTOR_SET_URI backfill inside the three S2 scripts).

Upload acceptance-sheet.md as a metafile (the proposition_fidelity correspondence artifact) and substitute ARTIFACT_PIN:acceptance-sheet in every spec's validation block (both .correspondence and .artifactPin, they must stay equal).
Publish the six standalone spec pins with metatask_publish_spec (specPinPlan value PUBLISH_SPEC_FIRST), scripts already VECTOR_SET_URI-backfilled; collect the six specPinIds.

Publish the task with metatask_publish (draftsFile mode, taskId metatask-v13-pilot, specPinByKey mapping the six SPEC_PIN:<key> placeholders, allowPreActivation: true). The root spec (s1-behavior-spec-lint) is written by this call.
Post the discovery buzz within 24h: title + the FULL task root pinId + #metatask.

scripts/metatask-v13-pilot/publish-harness.mts automates steps 3-6 in --broadcast mode and records every pinId into launch-record.json; default mode is a dry-run that prints the full pin plan without any chain write.

placeholderTokens.VECTOR_SET_URI: hardcoded placeholder inside spec-s2a-python.sh / spec-s2b-go.sh / spec-s2c-ts.sh; backfill with the uploaded vector-set metafile URI (vector-set/vector-set.tar.gz). Scripts treat an unresolved placeholder as invalid (exit 2), never fail.
placeholderTokens.BASE_BUNDLE_URI:<key>: workspace.baseRef placeholder in the three S2 specs (keys s2a-python-base / s2b-go-base / s2c-ts-harness-base); backfill with the uploaded bundle metafile URIs. spec-s2c-ts.sh additionally embeds a BASE_BUNDLE_URI constant for its vendor byte-diff (same backfill).
placeholderTokens.ARTIFACT_PIN:acceptance-sheet: validation.proposition_fidelity placeholder in all seven specs; backfill with the acceptance-sheet metafile pin (correspondence and artifactPin stay equal).
placeholderTokens.SPEC_PIN:<key>: node specid placeholder; backfilled from the six metatask_publish_spec results. S1's specid stays null - it inherits the task root spec.

policyNotes.roster: policy.split.rosterid omitted (no roster pin): pilot adjudication wants reviewer independence measured across the whole bot population; the local roster exclusion stays off so any non-publisher, non-submitter bot may verify (quorum 2, draft section 3.5). Pilot-only decision, not a protocol statement.
policyNotes.toolKeys: policy keys follow the metatask_publish tool's input shape: camelCase, with two tool quirks - the terminal-node key is 'finalnode' (all lowercase, not finalNode) and submitterShareBP sits at policy top level (the tool writes it into the on-chain split.submitterShareBP). On-chain the policy lands snake_case: mode/finalnode/verify_quorum/challenge_ttl_days/reward_sat/claim_ttl_hours/verify_window_hours/split.
policyNotes.zeroTtls: claimTtlHours/verifyWindowHours are 0 to signal intent (draft section 3.10): both carry no semantics in competitive mode; the tool normalizes them to 0 on-chain either way.
policyNotes.reward: rewardSat 0 (no escrow in v1.3 draft); settlement is symbolic shareBP only - the pilot tests mechanism, not money.

specCountNote: Seven specs for seven nodes (S1..S5 with S2 split into three language variants). The pilot task sheet's 'six spec scripts' counts the S2 template family once; on-chain each variant is its own pin (per-language inline content differs, and the wave-1 lesson applies: spec pins are never shared across nodes with different artifact contracts).

publish.title: MetaTask v1.3 pilot - Cross-Language Replay-Engine Conformance Suite
publish.brief: Competitive-mode pilot (protocol v1.3.0 draft): produce the cross-language conformance suite the protocol is blocked on - behavior spec + vector schema (S1), three independent replay engines (S2a Python / S2b Go / S2c TS adapter over the vendored reference engine), a 3-engine vector matrix (S3), a divergence report (S4), and a checksum-verified release (S5, terminal). Forks are welcome on every node; the first fully-verified chain to S5 wins; losing forks land in unpaidHistory. rewardSat is 0 - the pilot tests mechanism, not money.

rubric: Fresh-environment verification: download each artifact, sha256-verify against CHECKSUMS.txt, unpack, run each packaged engine's vector runner once - all exit 0 (machine-checked by the spec).
The three packaged engines' CANONICAL_SHA256 digests agree (machine-checked).
No machine-absolute paths in any distributed artifact (machine-checked scan; reviewer spot-checks archive listings).
docs/install.md is sufficient for a new engine author to conform (reviewer judgment).
The release index metaapp loads standalone and links every artifact + checksums (reviewer judgment).
Every RED/AMBER matrix cell has exactly one ATTR section (machine-checked bijection).
Every attribution declares severity and cites >= 1 behavior-spec clause C-NN (machine-checked).
Each attribution's classification (engine bug vs spec ambiguity) is argued, with a minimal reproduction (reviewer judgment).
Proposed fixes are implementable as written (reviewer judgment).
Spec ambiguities are routed to the protocol registration queue, never silently resolved (reviewer judgment).
All 16 legacy v1.2.1 vectors included byte-identical (machine-checked against the announced canonical sha256 106aa1f3bee8ebd48339ceb65f97a12e54247e1e831296a394a974c9cb22f2c4).
>= 8 new competitive-mode vectors, well-formed, unique ids (machine-checked).

The new vectors cover at minimum: fork race, fail-cascade, optimistic pipelining, amend freeze, challenge-blocked settlement, winning-chain settlement math, losing-fork unpaidHistory, ghost parentrefs (reviewer judgment).
The runner reproduces the published matrix from scratch (machine-checked under available toolchains; SKIP evidence must be re-run by the reviewer on a full machine).
Canonical sha256 equal across the three engine columns (machine-checked). Independent double-production of this node is explicitly encouraged (second competing S3 submission = ideal fork test).
CLI contract match: --events/--root/--now/--guard, canonJ stdout projection, exit codes 0/2/3 (machine-exercised via the runner; reviewer spot-checks --guard).
Zero third-party dependencies, stdlib only (machine-checked import + manifest scan).
Determinism: two runs byte-identical canonical digest (machine-checked).
Readable module structure (reviewer judgment).
Malformed events are skipped with notes, never crash the engine (reviewer judgment + vector coverage).
CLI contract match: --events/--root/--now/--guard, canonJ stdout projection, exit codes 0/2/3 (machine-exercised via the runner; reviewer spot-checks --guard).
Zero third-party dependencies (go.mod carries no external requires - machine-checked).
go build ./... clean, go vet ./... clean, CGO_ENABLED=0 static binary builds (machine-checked).
Determinism: two runs byte-identical canonical digest (machine-checked).
Idiomatic, readable Go module structure; malformed events never panic (reviewer judgment + vector coverage).
